title: Failure of integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison

result.label: Failure of integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison
result.statement: Disproves Yau's proposed Euclidean dimension bound for harmonic functions of integer growth on manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature. For every sufficiently large integer k , a complete smooth metric on ℝ 3 has at least (k+2)^2 independent harmonic functions of growth at most k , exceeding the Euclidean count (k+1)^2. The metric may depend on k .
